# Files whose change can silently change numerical results; a PR touching one needs the risk-tier evidence
# in its body (scripts/risk_tier.py). Globs are matched against repository-relative paths.
# Every pattern must match at least one file in R/ (scripts/test_risk_tier.py checks for dead patterns).

R/qprodnormal*.R

R/qMC.R

# MBCO tests
